title: Bit Set Operations
description: Write a Zig program that implements a fixed-size bit set with union, intersection, and difference operations.
verificationTest: output.includes('Union has 1: true') && output.includes('Union has 7: true') && output.includes('Inter has 3: true') && output.includes('Inter has 1: false')
hints: A bit set uses each bit of an integer to represent membership of an element
Use `@as(u64, 1) << idx` to create a bitmask for index idx
`|` for union, `&` for intersection, `& ~mask` for removal
The `~` operator inverts all bits in Zig
